recommended_next_steps: 1. PURCHASE: Contact ASEP (aseponline@gmail.com) to purchase a legitimate NSCP 2015 7th Edition copy. Price was ₱1,299–₱2,959 at retail.
2. EXTRACT: Once purchased, run PyMuPDF OCR extraction on the legitimate copy. Focus chapters: 1-5 (seismic), 9 (concrete serviceability), 4 (concrete embedment), wind load chapter.
3. CONVERT: Produce raw_markdown and refined_markdown in vitruvius-connection/002_Raw-Conversion-Layer/006 -Structural/.
4. UNBLOCK: After extraction, lea-strc-004-02, 007-03, 007-05, 012-01 become eligible for Batch 156+ reservation.
5. SECONDARY: For timber clusters (009-01, 009-02), also acquire NatCor timber standards or Philippine Forestry Code — NSCP alone may not suffice for species-specific durability/stress tables.
6. TIMELINE: Consider whether to wait for NSCP 2024 (8th Edition) instead, as it is the current edition. The 2015 edition may still be used for exam prep while the new edition transitions.
